questions.question: Femur measurements are most important in:

explanations.a: Femur measurements are not primarily used in embryology.
explanations.b: Femur measurements are not primarily related to neuroanatomy.
explanations.c: Femur measurements are important in forensic anthropology for estimating biological characteristics such as stature and sex.
explanations.d: Femur measurements are not primarily used in histology.

questions.question: Which femoral measurement is most useful for estimating stature?

explanations.a: Femoral neck length is not the primary measurement used for estimating stature.
explanations.b: Head diameter may be useful for other anthropological assessments but is not the primary measurement for stature estimation.
explanations.c: Maximum femoral length is one of the most important measurements used in estimating stature because it has a strong relationship with overall body height.
explanations.d: Shaft circumference is not the primary femoral measurement used for stature estimation.

questions.question: Bicondylar width of femur is the distance between:

explanations.a: Bicondylar width is measured as the maximum distance between the most lateral point of the lateral condyle and the most medial point of the medial condyle.
explanations.b: The anterior and posterior surfaces do not define the standard bicondylar width.
explanations.c: The intercondylar notch margins are used for other anatomical measurements and do not define bicondylar width.
explanations.d: The distance between the medial condyle and shaft is not the definition of bicondylar width.

questions.question: The linea aspera is located on the:

explanations.a: The linea aspera is not located on the anterior surface.
explanations.b: The linea aspera is not primarily located on the medial surface.
explanations.c: The linea aspera is a prominent longitudinal ridge located on the posterior surface of the shaft of the femur.
explanations.d: Interior surface is not an anatomical surface designation used for the location of the linea aspera.

questions.question: The angle between the neck and the shaft of the femur is called:

explanations.a: The femoral torsion angle refers to the angle between the axis of the femoral neck and the transverse axis of the femoral condyles.
explanations.b: The carrying angle is an angle of the upper limb formed at the elbow and is not a femoral measurement.
explanations.c: The angle formed between the longitudinal axis of the femoral neck and the longitudinal axis of the femoral shaft is called the neck-shaft angle.
explanations.d: The intercondylar angle is not the angle between the femoral neck and shaft.
